MILITARY JOBS BY ASVAB SCORE

ASVAB Score Requirements

The minimum AFQT for every branch, how each branch turns your section scores into job scores, and the scores needed for each job

Minimum AFQT by Branch

Your AFQT percentile decides whether you can enlist. These are the minimums for applicants with a high school diploma.

BranchMinimum AFQTJob scores usedJobs listed
U.S. Army3110 line scores (GT, CL, CO, EL, FA, GM, MM, OF, SC, ST)138
U.S. Air Force314 MAGE percentiles (Mechanical, Administrative, General, Electrical)111
U.S. Navy31Sums of section standard scores for each rating77
U.S. Marine Corps314 line scores (GT, MM, EL, CL)148
U.S. Coast Guard32Sums of section standard scores for each rating20

How Each Branch Scores Jobs

Once you can enlist, each branch combines your ASVAB section scores in its own way to decide which jobs are open to you. Pick a branch to see every job and the score it needs. Our GT score guide covers the score behind many technical jobs and officer programs.

U.S. Army

The Army combines your ASVAB section scores into 10 line scores. Each MOS sets a minimum on one or two of them, so your line scores decide which jobs are open to you.

Minimum AFQT: 31

  • 11B Infantryman
  • 11C Indirect Fire Infantryman
  • 12B Combat Engineer
  • 12N Horizontal Construction Engineer
  • 13B Cannon Crewmember
  • 15T UH-60 Helicopter Repairer/Aircrew Member
All 138 Army jobs and scores

U.S. Air Force

The Air Force (and Space Force) combines your section scores into four MAGE scores: Mechanical, Administrative, General, and Electrical. Each is reported as a percentile from 1 to 99, and each job (AFSC) sets a minimum on one or more of them.

Minimum AFQT: 31

  • 1A1X2 Mobility Force Aviator
  • 1A8X1 Airborne Cryptologic Language Analyst
  • 1B4X1 Cyber Warfare Operations
  • 1C1X1 Air Traffic Control
  • 1D7X1 Information Technology (IT) Systems
  • 1N0X1 All Source Intelligence Analyst
All 111 Air Force jobs and scores

U.S. Navy

The Navy does not use named composite scores. Each rating adds up specific section standard scores, such as VE + AR + MK + GS, and sets a minimum total. Many ratings accept more than one combination.

Minimum AFQT: 31

  • AD Aviation Machinist's Mate
  • AECF Advanced Electronics Computer Field (ET, FC)
  • AO Aviation Ordnanceman
  • AT Aviation Electronics Technician
  • BM Boatswain's Mate
  • CS Culinary Specialist
All 77 Navy jobs and scores

U.S. Marine Corps

The Marine Corps combines your section scores into four line scores: General Technical (GT), Mechanical Maintenance (MM), Electronics (EL), and Clerical (CL). Each MOS sets a minimum on one or more of them. Recruits usually enlist into a program field and are assigned a specific MOS during training.

Minimum AFQT: 31

  • 0111 Administrative Specialist
  • 0231 Intelligence Specialist
  • 0311 Rifleman
  • 0331 Machine Gunner
  • 0341 Mortarman
  • 0351 Infantry Assault Marine
All 148 Marine Corps jobs and scores

U.S. Coast Guard

Like the Navy, the Coast Guard adds up specific section standard scores for each rating, such as VE + AR, and sets a minimum total. A few ratings also set a minimum on a single section.

Minimum AFQT: 32

  • AET Avionics Electrical Technician
  • AMT Aviation Maintenance Technician
  • AST Aviation Survival Technician
  • BM Boatswain's Mate
  • CS Culinary Specialist
  • DC Damage Controlman
All 20 Coast Guard jobs and scores
